purpose: Iterative (D'Agostini) unfolding through pyunfold or RooUnfold with the plugin's own validation: nominal and reweighted closure, stress tests and toy coverage for a regularization declared before the run; agreement with core/stats/unfolding_diagnostics.py up to 60 bins
environment: local scratch venv outside the repository: Python 3.13.2, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, pyunfold 0.5.0 (2026-10-17); no CI job; RooUnfold is not part of ROOT and was not available (Homebrew ROOT 6.38.04 has no RooUnfoldBayes)
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses: pyunfold was run on synthetic inputs, the RooUnfold path is documented and not run
